decisions.statement: A null pending action is a break.
restart-now is the only action handled.
Every other action breaks the loop.
The maintenance flag is read off the pending record rather than off the event.
A directive is either continue or break.
Nothing here touches a process or a seat page or a database.
The directive union is spelled out here and again in the handlers module.

definition: which directive the loop takes from whatever action was pending at the child's exit
